system.description:
Gained at Level 12. Once per day.

You absorb your Lordling into your Soul Armament and tap into its energy. You gain the following benefits for a number of Rounds equal to your Soul.

  • Your Focused Attacks deal additional damage equal to your Lordling's Spirit.
  • You gain +2 to Movement and Running Speed.
  • You can use Tactics that normally require your Lordling on yourself instead. If the Tactic requires both of you to act together, it cannot be used this way.
  • You benefit from any Passive Tactics your Lordling knows.
  • While active, your Lordling cannot be targeted by Attacks, Abilities or Spells and cannot take damage.
